statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-8932: libcurl could reuse a connection from its pool even after mTLS options that should prevent reuse, in particular options for the client private key, had been changed, because they were left out of the connection and TLS session matching checks (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-8932.html). It affects libcurl from 7.7 to 8.20.0 (not the curl tool) and was fixed in curl 8.21.0 by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/7541ae569d82fb308a5e2d94916027da4fa3ba3e. The DHI curl packages for Alpine 3.23 are builds of curl 8.17.0-r1, 8.18.0-r0 (in both the main and the security repository), 8.19.0-r0, 8.20.0-r0, 8.20.0-r1, 8.21.0-r0, 8.22.0-r0, 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1, and the version string in each build's libcurl matches its package version. Every build before 8.21.0-r0 is a curl release in the affected range, and 8.21.0-r0 is the first build of curl 8.21.0, so it is the first fixed build.
